s1.syndrome_frame: Acute abdominal pain in early pregnancy
salient_findings: Epigastric pain radiating to the lower abdomen
Epigastric tenderness without rebound or guarding
Empty uterus with a left adnexal structure on ultrasound
key_facts: No fever, nausea, vomiting, or vaginal bleeding
Transvaginal ultrasound showed an empty uterus
1.2 cm left adnexal structure with minimal vascularity
Small amount of free fluid in the pouch of Douglas

raw.syndrome_frame: Acute abdominal pain in early pregnancy
salient_findings: Epigastric pain radiating to the lower abdomen
Epigastric tenderness without rebound or guarding
Empty uterus with a left adnexal structure on ultrasound
key_facts: No fever, nausea, vomiting, or vaginal bleeding
Transvaginal ultrasound showed an empty uterus
1.2 cm left adnexal structure with minimal vascularity
Small amount of free fluid in the pouch of Douglas

differentials: Adnexal torsion of a paratubal cyst
per_call: Adnexal torsion of a paratubal cyst

shortlist.label: Ectopic pregnancy
shortlist.why_kept: β-hCG level below the discriminatory zone, empty uterine cavity on ultrasound, and adnexal structure with minimal vascularity

shortlist.label: Ovarian torsion
shortlist.why_kept: Acute abdominal pain, adnexal structure with minimal vascularity, and presence of free fluid in the pouch of Douglas

shortlist.label: Ruptured ovarian cyst
shortlist.why_kept: Acute abdominal pain, adnexal structure, and presence of free fluid in the pouch of Douglas

shortlist.label: Appendicitis
shortlist.why_kept: Epigastric pain radiating to the lower abdomen, elevated white blood cell count, and presence of free fluid in the pouch of Douglas

shortlist.label: Ruptured corpus luteum cyst
shortlist.why_kept: Acute abdominal pain, adnexal structure, and presence of free fluid in the pouch of Douglas in the context of early pregnancy

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation with epigastric pain, empty uterus on ultrasound, and a β-hCG level below the discriminatory zone, along with the presence of an adnexal structure, is highly suggestive of an ectopic pregnancy

rejected.label: Ovarian torsion
rejected.why: The patient has minimal vascularity of the adnexal structure, which is less typical for ovarian torsion

rejected.label: Ruptured ovarian cyst
rejected.why: The presence of an adnexal structure with minimal vascularity and the patient's β-hCG level suggest a pregnancy-related condition

rejected.label: Appendicitis
rejected.why: The location of the pain and the absence of rebound or guarding make appendicitis less likely

rejected.label: Ruptured corpus luteum cyst
rejected.why: The patient's β-hCG level and the presence of an adnexal structure are more consistent with an ectopic pregnancy than a ruptured corpus luteum cyst
